name: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2
what: Build a theme park, design coasters, and keep guests happy.

fanProjects.name: OpenRCT2
fanProjects.what: Fans rebuilt the game's engine so it runs great on today's computers, with online play and bigger parks.
howToPlay: Own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 (it is often on sale on Steam or GOG).
Download OpenRCT2 and point it at your game folder the first time it opens.

lovedFeatures: Place rides, paths and shops on a grid
Money that goes up and down
Guests who walk around and have needs
